title: 第6章 叶闻白：怜儿心跳得好快
novel_title: 贵族学院平民盲女怎么成了白月光
content_zh:
果然，叶闻白又不说话了。

    安怜以为他又要被说服，但下一秒，他上前一步，高大的身躯将安怜笼罩在他的阴影里。

    清冽好闻的气息铺天盖地地涌过来，淡淡的，混合着他身上灼热的温度。

    安怜鼻腔里全是这个味道，心脏砰砰直跳。

    她分不清自己是在害怕还是在害羞，只觉得心跳快得不像话，像是要从胸腔里蹦出来。

    “哥哥……”她下意识后退半步，后脚跟磕在花坛的边缘上，差点摔倒。

    叶闻白伸手揽住她的腰，稳稳扶住她，微微低头，凑近她的耳畔。

    “我不在乎别人的看法。”他说。

    声音低沉，温热的气息拂过她的耳廓，痒痒的。

    安怜一个激灵，耳朵瞬间爬上红晕。

    这个人，说话就好好说话，靠那么近干什么！

    她看不见，所以她的其他感官比常人敏锐得多，尤其是耳朵。

    “哥哥……”她又喊了一声，语气带着明显的求饶。

    叶闻白没有退开。

    他就着这个姿势，低头，鼻尖蹭过她的发顶，深深吸了一口气。

    然后，他笑了。

    笑声从喉咙溢出，带着些沙哑，还有点说不清道不明的危险。

    “怜儿心跳得好快。”他说。

    安怜：“…………”

    她能不跳得快吗！

    靠她这么近，还用这种声音说话，她的心脏要是跳得慢就该去做检查了！

    “哥哥，你、你离我远一点……”安怜伸手去推他的胸膛。

    叶闻白握住她的手，轻轻把玩着。

    “为什么要离远一点？”他问，语气无辜极了，“怜儿不喜欢哥哥靠近吗？”

    安怜想说是。

    但她不敢。

    “不是不喜欢……”安怜艰难地组织语言，“就是……太近了，我有点……喘不过气。”

    叶闻白闻言，犹豫片刻后退开半步，牵着她继续往前走。

    “今晚我来接你。”他说，语气不容拒绝。
content_en:
Sure enough, Ye Wenbai stopped talking again.

    An Lian thought he was about to be persuaded again, but the next second, he took a step forward, and his tall body shrouded An Lian in his shadow.

    The clear and delicious breath rushed over overwhelmingly, faint, mixed with the scorching temperature of his body.

    An Lian's nose was filled with this smell, and her heart was beating fast.

    She couldn't tell whether she was scared or shy. She only felt that her heartbeat was so fast that it felt like it was about to jump out of her chest.

    "Brother..." She subconsciously took a half step back, her heels hit the edge of the flower bed, and she almost fell.

    Ye Wenbai put his arms around her waist, held her steady, lowered his head slightly, and leaned close to her ear.

    "I don't care what other people think," he said.

    The voice was low, and the warm breath tickled her ears.

    An Lian was shocked, and her ears instantly turned red.

    This man, just talk nicely, why are you so close?

    She can't see, so her other senses are much sharper than normal, especially her ears.

    "Brother..." She shouted again, her tone obviously begging for mercy.

    Ye Wenbai did not retreat.

    In this position, he lowered his head, brushed the tip of his nose against the top of her hair, and took a deep breath.

    Then he laughed.

    The laughter escaped from his throat, with a bit of hoarseness, and a bit of unexplainable danger.

    "Lian'er's heart is beating so fast." He said.

    An Lian: "…………"

    Can she not dance fast!

    Being so close to her and talking in such a voice, if her heart is beating slowly, she needs to get checked out!

    "Brother, you, stay away from me..." An Lian reached out and pushed his chest.

    Ye Wenbai held her hand and played with it gently.

    "Why do you want to stay away?" He asked, his tone was extremely innocent, "Don't you like your brother to be close to you?"

    An Lian wanted to say yes.

    But she didn't dare.

    "It's not that I don't like it..." An Lian struggled to organize her words, "It's just that... it's too close and I can't breathe."

    When Ye Wenbai heard this, he hesitated for a moment and stepped back, holding her hand and continuing to walk forward.

    "I'll pick you up tonight," he said, his tone not allowing for rejection.
title_en: Chapter 6 Ye Wenbai: Lian'er's heart beats so fast
